Exemption granted, subject to just exceptions.
Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.
At the outset it is noticed that certain photographs of the prosecutrix/respondent No.2 have been filed as Annexure-D to this petition.

2. Mr. Vagisha Kochar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the photographs were annexed only to show the consensual nature of the relationship between the petitioner and the prosecutrix.

3. Be that as it may, to protect the confidentiality and privacy of the prosecutrix, the Registry is directed to delete Annexure-D to the petition and destroy the photographs appearing in that annexure.
4. The petitioner is cautioned not to repeat such action.
If the petitioner wishes to cite any photographs or other similar material that identifies the prosecutrix in support of his case, he may present the same by way of a sealed envelope to the court.

5. By way of the present petition filed under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioner seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 653/2022 dated 18.10.2022 registered at P.S.: Punjabi Aditya Raj vs State And Anr on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69208972/
1 Bagh, pursuant to which chargesheet has been filed under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sections 66E/67/67A of the Information Technology Act, 2000.
6.

8. Let status report be filed within 04 weeks; with copy to the opposing counsel.
9.
Let updated nominal roll be requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent for the next date.

10. Let intimation under section 439(1-A) Cr.P.C. read with the Delhi High Court Practice Directions dated 24.09.2019 in form Annexure-A attached to the Practice Directions, be sent by the Investigating Officer to the complainant, informing her that her presence is required at the hearing of this bail application on the next date.
11. Re-notify on 30th May 2023.
